0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the Northwest, W4) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (6-2, 2nd in the Northwest, L1) with both teams having won most of their recent games, and the Thunder are 3-2 on the road this season. The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 124-95 win over Portland in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet. Out for Oklahoma City are Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber, while Portland is without Ja Morant, Robert Williams III, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci.
